contentList.content: This companion will not join combat.
Enable to make this companion not join combat.

Enable to make non-combatant companions who are grouped with you teleport to you when they reappear after combat. If this is disabled, noncombatants do not move from where they were before combat started.
If combat ended because the players fled a hostile area, then non-combatants are always teleported to you, even if this setting is disabled.
Enable to force non-combatants to temporarily stop existing, even if no combat is happening.
Non-combatants are forced to temporarily stop existing, even if no combat is happening.
Non-combatants won't join dialogues while this is enabled.
This cannot be toggled while any combat is in progress.
Enable to make this companion not join combat.
This cannot be toggled while any combat is in progress.
Enable to force non-combatants to temporarily stop existing, even if no combat is happening.
